verses.ar: رُوحُ ٱلسَّيِّدِ ٱلرَّبِّ عَلَيَّ، لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ مَسَحَنِي لِأُبَشِّرَ ٱلْمَسَاكِينَ، أَرْسَلَنِي لِأَعْصِبَ مُنْكَسِرِي ٱلْقَلْبِ، لِأُنَادِيَ لِلْمَسْبِيِّينَ بِٱلْعِتْقِ، وَلِلْمَأْسُورِينَ بِٱلْإِطْلَاقِ.
verses.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord GOD [is] upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to [them that are] bound;
verses.web: The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound,
verses.he: ר֛וּחַ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה עָלָ֑י יַ֡עַן מָשַׁח֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֹתִ֜י לְבַשֵּׂ֣ר עֲנָוִ֗ים שְׁלָחַ֙נִי֙ לַחֲבֹ֣שׁ לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵ֔ב לִקְרֹ֤א לִשְׁבוּיִם֙ דְּרֹ֔ור וְלַאֲסוּרִ֖ים פְּקַח־קֹֽוחַ׃

verses.ar: لِأُنَادِيَ بِسَنَةٍ مَقْبُولَةٍ لِلرَّبِّ، وَبِيَوْمِ ٱنْتِقَامٍ لِإِلَهِنَا. لِأُعَزِّيَ كُلَّ ٱلنَّائِحِينَ.
verses.kjv: To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;
verses.web: to proclaim the year of Yahweh’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,
verses.he: לִקְרֹ֤א שְׁנַת־רָצֹון֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְיֹ֥ום נָקָ֖ם לֵאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְנַחֵ֖ם כָּל־אֲבֵלִֽים׃

verses.ar: لِأَجْعَلَ لِنَائِحِي صِهْيَوْنَ، لِأُعْطِيَهُمْ جَمَالًا عِوَضًا عَنِ ٱلرَّمَادِ، وَدُهْنَ فَرَحٍ عِوَضًا عَنِ ٱلنَّوْحِ، وَرِدَاءَ تَسْبِيحٍ عِوَضًا عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ ٱلْيَائِسَةِ، فَيُدْعَوْنَ أَشْجَارَ ٱلْبِرِّ، غَرْسَ ٱلرَّبِّ لِلتَّمْجِيدِ.
verses.kjv: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
verses.web: to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of Yahweh, that he may be glorified.
verses.he: לָשׂ֣וּם ׀ לַאֲבֵלֵ֣י צִיֹּ֗ון לָתֵת֩ לָהֶ֨ם פְּאֵ֜ר תַּ֣חַת אֵ֗פֶר שֶׁ֤מֶן שָׂשֹׂון֙ תַּ֣חַת אֵ֔בֶל מַעֲטֵ֣ה תְהִלָּ֔ה תַּ֖חַת ר֣וּחַ כֵּהָ֑ה וְקֹרָ֤א לָהֶם֙ אֵילֵ֣י הַצֶּ֔דֶק מַטַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לְהִתְפָּאֵֽר׃

verses.ar: وَيَبْنُونَ ٱلْخِرَبَ ٱلْقَدِيمَةَ. يُقِيمُونَ ٱلْمُوحِشَاتِ ٱلْأُوَلَ، وَيُجَدِّدُونَ ٱلْمُدُنَ ٱلْخَرِبَةَ، مُوحِشَاتِ دَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
verses.web: They will rebuild the old ruins. They will raise up the former devastated places. They will repair the ruined cities that have been devastated for many generations.
verses.he: וּבָנוּ֙ חָרְבֹ֣ות עֹולָ֔ם שֹׁמְמֹ֥ות רִֽאשֹׁנִ֖ים יְקֹומֵ֑מוּ וְחִדְּשׁוּ֙ עָ֣רֵי חֹ֔רֶב שֹׁמְמֹ֖ות דֹּ֥ור וָדֹֽור׃

verses.ar: وَيَقِفُ ٱلْأَجَانِبُ وَيَرْعَوْنَ غَنَمَكُمْ، وَيَكُونُ بَنُو ٱلْغَرِيبِ حَرَّاثِيكُمْ وَكَرَّامِيكُمْ.
verses.kjv: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien [shall be] your plowmen and your vinedressers.
verses.web: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards.
verses.he: וְעָמְד֣וּ זָרִ֔ים וְרָע֖וּ צֹאנְכֶ֑ם וּבְנֵ֣י נֵכָ֔ר אִכָּרֵיכֶ֖ם וְכֹרְמֵיכֶֽם׃

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنْتُمْ فَتُدْعَوْنَ كَهَنَةَ ٱلرَّبِّ، تُسَمَّوْنَ خُدَّامَ إِلَهِنَا. تَأْكُلُونَ ثَرْوَةَ ٱلْأُمَمِ، وَعَلَى مَجْدِهِمْ تَتَأَمَّرُونَ.
verses.kjv: But ye shall be named the Priests of the LORD: [men] shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
verses.web: But you will be called Yahweh’s priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.
verses.he: וְאַתֶּ֗ם כֹּהֲנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ תִּקָּרֵ֔אוּ מְשָׁרְתֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ יֵאָמֵ֖ר לָכֶ֑ם חֵ֤יל גֹּויִם֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ וּבִכְבֹודָ֖ם תִּתְיַמָּֽרוּ׃

verses.ar: عِوَضًا عَنْ خِزْيِكُمْ ضِعْفَانِ، وَعِوَضًا عَنِ ٱلْخَجَلِ يَبْتَهِجُونَ بِنَصِيبِهِمْ. لِذَلِكَ يَرِثُونَ فِي أَرْضِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ. بَهْجَةٌ أَبَدِيَّةٌ تَكُونُ لَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: ¶ For your shame [ye shall have] double; and [for] confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
verses.web: Instead of your shame you will have double. Instead of dishonor, they will rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double. Everlasting joy will be to them.
verses.he: תַּ֤חַת בָּשְׁתְּכֶם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֔ה וּכְלִמָּ֖ה יָרֹ֣נּוּ חֶלְקָ֑ם לָכֵ֤ן בְּאַרְצָם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֣ה יִירָ֔שׁוּ שִׂמְחַ֥ת עֹולָ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: «لِأَنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ مُحِبُّ ٱلْعَدْلِ، مُبْغِضُ ٱلْمُخْتَلِسِ بِٱلظُّلْمِ. وَأَجْعَلُ أُجْرَتَهُمْ أَمِينَةً، وَأَقْطَعُ لَهُمْ عَهْدًا أَبَدِيًّا.
verses.kjv: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.web: “For I, Yahweh, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.he: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֹהֵ֣ב מִשְׁפָּ֔ט שֹׂנֵ֥א גָזֵ֖ל בְּעֹולָ֑ה וְנָתַתִּ֤י פְעֻלָּתָם֙ בֶּאֱמֶ֔ת וּבְרִ֥ית עֹולָ֖ם אֶכְרֹ֥ות לָהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: وَيُعْرَفُ بَيْنَ ٱلْأُمَمِ نَسْلُهُمْ، وَذُرِّيَّتُهُمْ فِي وَسَطِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ. كُلُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَرَوْنَهُمْ يَعْرِفُونَهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ نَسْلٌ بَارَكَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ».
verses.kjv: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they [are] the seed [which] the LORD hath blessed.
verses.web: Their offspring will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge them, that they are the offspring which Yahweh has blessed.”
verses.he: וְנֹודַ֤ע בַּגֹּויִם֙ זַרְעָ֔ם וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֖ם בְּתֹ֣וךְ הָעַמִּ֑ים כָּל־רֹֽאֵיהֶם֙ יַכִּיר֔וּם כִּ֛י הֵ֥ם זֶ֖רַע בֵּרַ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: فَرَحًا أَفْرَحُ بِٱلرَّبِّ. تَبْتَهِجُ نَفْسِي بِإِلَهِي، لِأَنَّهُ قَدْ أَلْبَسَنِي ثِيَابَ ٱلْخَلَاصِ. كَسَانِي رِدَاءَ ٱلْبِرِّ، مِثْلَ عَرِيسٍ يَتَزَيَّنُ بِعِمَامَةٍ، وَمِثْلَ عَرُوسٍ تَتَزَيَّنُ بِحُلِيِّهَا.
verses.kjv: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh [himself] with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth [herself] with her jewels.
verses.web: I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
verses.he: שֹׂ֧ושׂ אָשִׂ֣ישׂ בַּֽיהוָ֗ה תָּגֵ֤ל נַפְשִׁי֙ בֵּֽאלֹהַ֔י כִּ֤י הִלְבִּישַׁ֙נִי֙ בִּגְדֵי־יֶ֔שַׁע מְעִ֥יל צְדָקָ֖ה יְעָטָ֑נִי כֶּֽחָתָן֙ יְכַהֵ֣ן פְּאֵ֔ר וְכַכַּלָּ֖ה תַּעְדֶּ֥ה כֵלֶֽיהָ׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ كَمَا أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ تُخْرِجُ نَبَاتَهَا، وَكَمَا أَنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ تُنْبِتُ مَزْرُوعَاتِهَا، هَكَذَا ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ يُنْبِتُ بِرًّا وَتَسْبِيحًا أَمَامَ كُلِّ ٱلْأُمَمِ.
verses.kjv: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
verses.web: For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord Yahweh will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
verses.he: כִּ֤י כָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תֹּוצִ֣יא צִמְחָ֔הּ וּכְגַנָּ֖ה זֵרוּעֶ֣יהָ תַצְמִ֑יחַ כֵּ֣ן ׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה יַצְמִ֤יחַ צְדָקָה֙ וּתְהִלָּ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד כָּל־הַגֹּויִֽם׃
